description: Epson FC-135 32.768 kHz fundamental tuning-fork crystal unit in a 3.2 x 1.5 x 0.9 mm (max) SMD package with two terminals. Product number Q13FC13500004: load capacitance 12.5 pF, frequency tolerance ±20 x10^-6 at +25 °C, ESR 70 kΩ, C0 1.0 pF typ, drive level 0.5 µW max, -40 to +85 °C. For MCU sub-clocks and BLE sleep clocks.

name: Epson FC-135 32.768 kHz Crystal, 12.5 pF ±20 ppm

params.level_of_drive_note: maximum level of drive at which the unit is not destroyed (0.5 typ)

params.note: +85 to +105 C and 0.5-1.0 uW drive are available on request to Epson.

Keep the PCB lines to the crystal as short as possible; long lines can cause abnormal oscillation. Do not place signal, power or GND lines in the mounting area, its inner layers or its back side, and keep signal lines away from the part. Design the oscillator so its negative resistance is at least five times the crystal's ESR, and keep the drive level within the specification.

Frequency drifts parabolically with temperature: Δf = B (Ti - T)^2 with B = -0.04 x10^-6/C^2 max and Ti = +25 ± 5 C (at B max and Ti = 25 C: -169 x10^-6 at -40 C and -144 x10^-6 at +85 C; the data sheet's simulation figure shows the curve).

At most three reflows (standard profile: 170 C preheat 100 s, 220 C for 35 s, 260 C max). Rework with a soldering iron at 350 C max within 5 s. Ultrasonic cleaning may damage the crystal; avoid condensation and excessive shock.

Q13FC13500004 is FC-135 32.768 kHz, CL 12.5 pF, ±20 x10^-6. Other FC-135 numbers: Q13FC13500002 (7 pF), Q13FC13500003 (9 pF; LCSC C99010, extended part), Q13FC13500005 (12.5 pF, ±10 x10^-6). The FC-135R (X1A000141..., 50 kΩ max) and the FC-135 TYPE (Q14FC1350..., 32-76.8 kHz) are separate products. LCSC C32346 is this number (JLCPCB basic part). Load capacitors on the board are chosen for CL = 12.5 pF.

params.resolution: Use 70 kΩ as the maximum: Epson's per-number data and the brief sheet state it as a limit, and an oscillator sized for a 70 kΩ maximum also covers a 70 kΩ typical. Oscillator margin is checked against 5 x 70 kΩ = 350 kΩ.

params.note: Epson publishes FC-135 3D CAD data behind a click-through licence: a personal, non-transferable licence to design boards that use Epson crystals, with no copying, modification or distribution. It is not redistributable, and the agreement was not accepted, so nothing was downloaded. Geometry is generated from the data sheet outline drawing [7] (library/cad/py/catalog/epson-fc-135-32k768-12p5.py).
Epson gives no package code or outline name beyond '3.2 x 1.5 mm'. LCSC's 'SMD3215-2P' is a distributor label.
Not stated; a crystal unit at under 1 uW drive dissipates no meaningful heat.

params.reason: The drawing dimensions the body, the pads and the 0.35 metallization height only. The end and side views show that metallization only at the corner castellations (blocks about 0.2 wide), with the middle of the end face bare, and the bottom view runs each pad out to those castellations; the castellation radius and lining thickness are scaled from those views so the representative model has single values. The pad is kept as the dimensioned rectangle, so its outer corners overlap the castellation openings slightly. The model uses the maximum height so clearance checks are conservative. The bottom view is a third-angle projection about the length axis, so #1 is on the -X end; the crystal is not polarised.
params.value: nominal body 3.2 x 1.5 at the 0.9 mm maximum height; terminal thickness 0.03; ceramic base top at z = 0.6; lid 2.7 x 1.1 with 0.15 corner radius from z = 0.6 to 0.9; corner castellation radius 0.2; castellation lining 0.02 thick and 0.35 high, in the two corner castellations of each end only; each bottom pad the full 0.65 x 1.3 rectangle, its outer corners running into the two linings at its end; terminal #1 at -X
